whoTheyAre.summary: The current PeopleGroups.org record identifies Dendi in Benin and ties the record to Dendi (Benin) (ddn). claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record PG012316 reports PEID 12316, display name Dendi, country Benin and primary language Dendi (Benin) (ddn).
Glottolog identifies Dendi (Benin) with glottocode dend1243 and ISO 639-3 code ddn and lists Benin, Niger and Nigeria among its countries.

Independent linguistic and historical sources describe Dendi as a wider-communication language in northern Benin and document historical lingua-franca use in Borgu towns such as Parakou, Djougou and Kandi.
claims.interpretationNote: The historical source discusses regional Dendi-speaking communities and trade-language functions; it is not used to assert one ancestry, occupation or migration story for every person represented by PG012316.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record reports 'Islam - Folk' as the aggregate primary-religion label for PG012316.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a provider classification for one people-group-in-country record, not a statement about every Dendi person's belief or practice.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record reports GSEC 1, less than 2% evangelical presence and no recent church-planting activity for PG012316; it also reports the record as Engaged, with congregations existing.
